name: calibration_not_official_field
label: 标定房间
provenance: User-defined calibration geometry; no geometry reconstructed from RoboMaster preview images.
wall_segment_convention: Finite room interior faces. Endpoints are not wall centerlines. Heights are closed intervals in world coordinates. Ground, targets and their supports are excluded from this wall-only map.

initialization.source: Configured initial positions in calibration-room coordinates.
initialization.height_input: Exact configured world height in metres.
initialization.estimator_restriction: Use these priors once at initialization. Live engine poses and target world poses are evaluator/spawner data, not estimator observations.

target_geometry.name: competition_armor_mock
target_geometry.endpoint_order: strip at negative local Y bottom/top, strip at positive local Y top/bottom; image left/right depends on optical-frame conversion
target_geometry.rendering_limit: Emissive material creates rendered colored strips; radiometry, bloom, camera intrinsics and exposure are not hardware calibrated.

sensor_systems.note: Systems do not create sensors. Parent robot models supply sensor elements. NavSat is available for SITL plumbing; it is not an anchor-free localization observation.

limitations: No ceiling. Returns above z=4 or beyond segment endpoints cannot be matched to room walls.
Ground and mock-target returns require separate models or rejection by the estimator.
Repeated target appearance does not establish target identity.
waypoint_provenance: Hand-authored prior-map calibration routes, not live target or vehicle truth. Endpoint is acquisition region, final guidance uses rendered pixels.
